tagline: Practical, no-hype design ideas for Indian homes.
niche: home interiors, small-space furniture, kitchen organisation and simple DIY for Indian homes and rented flats
about_text: Small Room Ideas is a collection of practical design guides for compact Indian homes. Each guide explains why an idea works (light, circulation, storage, proportion) and links to Amazon.in search results for the type of product discussed, so you can compare options yourself.
